instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium full shot. In an indoor ballet studio with a wooden barre, the young girl in a black leotard and skirt (R1) sits on the floor on the left with her legs extended forward and hands on her hips, looking down-right. The scene is illuminated by soft, diffused indoor lighting, creating a neutral color palette.
